duration: 2 years from the date of signing, with confidentiality obligations surviving for an additional 2 years after termination.

financial_value.payment_terms: Not applicable — non-monetary confidentiality agreement. A liquidated damages penalty applies in case of breach (see penalty_clauses).

termination_clauses: Either party may terminate the discussions with 15 days' written notice.
penalty_clauses: Liquidated damages of SAR 100,000 payable in the event of a breach of confidentiality.
governing_law: Laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
language_precedence_clause: In case of conflict, the Arabic version shall prevail.
